set_config_env_vars: set environment variable configuration values like AR_LOG_LEVEL or AR_USE_MODELSCOPE using set_config
check_is_set: check if an environment variable like AR_LOG_LEVEL is explicitly set in the process environment
access_env_var_lazy: access a lazy-evaluated environment variable like AR_LOG_LEVEL as a module attribute
list_env_vars: list all available environment variable names using dir on the envs module
inspect_environment_variables_dict: inspect the environment_variables dictionary to see all registered env var lambdas and defaults
